request:
Rebuild Ada's visible SPA as a faithful educational adaptation of Buzz desktop at commit 0720f5380ce8a6c050afac159f8462c06cd51ab5, using research/2026-08-23-buzz-ui-map.md as the complete source inventory and keeping Ada's existing local TypeScript server/SQLite/runner architecture (do not import Buzz's Rust, Nostr, relay, repo, or runtime architecture). The delivered product must be a complete working chat/configuration surface, not a static mockup.

Visual and navigation scope: reproduce Buzz's fixed full-viewport gradient frame, compact top chrome, ~300px collapsible sidebar, rounded inset content surface, typography/density, active/hover/focus states, responsive mobile drawer, history back/forward, keyboard shortcuts, loading/error/empty states, and light/dark/system appearance. Routes remain hash-driven (no router dependency): inbox/activity, channels, agents, and settings. Remove the visible Modules, My study, and dedicated Card File/document surfaces from Ada's navigation and routing for this phase. Also omit Buzz Canvas/docs, Pulse, Projects/repos, Workflows, huddles, and Nostr-specific onboarding. Existing cards and modules remain persisted backend knowledge for agents and may still appear as inline chat publication/citation content, but are not standalone user pages.

Chat scope: working channel timeline and thread panel, day/unread separators, people/agent identities, message composer with @mentions, reply/thread context, markdown/code affordances, attachment selection and display, optimistic/pending/error/retry states, message edit/delete, emoji reactions, draft persistence per channel/thread, search/command palette, and live updates. Adapt Buzz's labels and content to cohort-based education, using channels grouped as Course, Work, and Private.

Channel scope: working create, edit/configure, archive/unarchive, and delete flows backed by the local API and SQLite. Configuration includes name, description, Course/Work/Private group, open/private visibility, member membership, assigned agents, work status/due date when relevant, confirmation and server errors. Deleting non-empty channels must be refused safely with an archive recommendation rather than cascading historical learning data.

Agent scope: working Agents catalog plus create/edit/configure/remove flows backed by the local API and SQLite. Configuration includes name, description, system instructions, community/personal scope, runtime (scripted/claude), optional model label, channel assignments, deterministic figure reroll, presence/status, and a generated agent token/setup command. Provider credentials never enter the Ada server; the runner remains external and uses its own environment. Removing an agent with authored history must be refused safely; inactive/archive behavior should preserve history.

Settings scope: course/profile, appearance, agent runner setup, invites, and keyboard shortcuts only. Do not invent grading, broad permissions, billing, SSO, notifications, multi-course, or personalization. Membership gating and owner/invite behavior from the existing Railway feature must remain functional.

Architecture and quality: extend packages/protocol, apps/server DB/API/events, and apps/web through normal typed APIs and explicit SQLite migrations; update AGENTS.md files and DECISIONS.md with a new dated decision that supersedes only the old custom UI/page constraints, not the local server/runner decision. Preserve English-only content and Ada's human/agent identity rules. Use existing shadcn/Base UI primitives where appropriate, follow the Impeccable craft floor and React performance guidance, avoid hacks. Verify with typecheck, lint (no new warnings), build, server/runner checks, smoke/gated/e2e checks, targeted CRUD/chat tests, and browser screenshots at desktop and narrow widths, followed by an independent UI/code review.
message: Integrated capability changes: agent-management, app-settings, channel-management, chat-workspace, course-membership, course-modules, student-study

reasons.delivered: delivered has not been proven by a durable receipt.
reasons.published: published has not been proven by a durable receipt.
